svg.title: AVC Encoder Mode — AMVP to MRG Skip Reuse Data Flow
svg.desc: RTL-derived original AVC encoder flow. AMVP produces the spatial median predictor and its normal inter result, while a blk16-only AVC sideband injects the P-Skip candidate and metadata into the Merge subsystem so its MC cost and CCU result infrastructure can be reused.
svg.text: AVC Encoder Mode — AMVP → MRG Skip Reuse
Remote main/src_encoder_ref · reg_avc_mode = 1 · MRG is reused as the blk16 P-Skip evaluation path
LANE 1 — AVC AMVP PREDICTOR AND NORMAL INTER RESULT
FME supplies actual MV and ref_idx.
AMVP command push excludes I/skip/terminate CUs.
• schedule blk8 / blk16 and traverse active refs
• read/stage spatial A/B neighbors and shared ref data
• launch candidate generation after neighbor completion
The shared reader may stage Col/Ref information,
but AVC candidate selection below uses the spatial median.
C = B0 when available, otherwise B2.
Scaling waits are bypassed; AVC exits directly
to candidate done after forming the median result.
• pair FME MV with cand0 at fme_ref_idx
• candidate 0 is fixed; no cand0/cand1 cost compare
AMVP result = {FME MV, MVD, ref/poc/long, MVBS}
The same blk16 pop also creates the AVC Skip sideband.
same CCU is shown again in lane 3 for the Skip result
MV / MVD / ref_idx / pocdiff / long / MVBS
This is the ordinary inter-prediction result path.
The Skip evaluation below is an additional parallel result.
Final coding-mode selection is outside the MVP subsystem.
LANE 2 — BLK16 P-SKIP SIDEBAND, MRG INJECTION AND MC EVALUATION
ve_amvp_top · triggered only by blk16 AMVP output
zero_condition is asserted at the implemented top/left
boundary or usable zero-MV neighbor conditions.
only the blk16 storage lane is active
Both depth-1 FIFOs are released by the same MC-cost handshake.
Normal Merge candidate 0/1 comparison is not used
to form the AVC Skip candidate.
Cost payload contains SATD and SSE.
The cost handshake is the FIFO-pop/result-pack event.
front end sees an I-slice gate and does not launch.
The downstream MC-cost and result FIFOs remain active.
active source = AMVP avc_* sideband only
LANE 3 — COST CAPTURE, SKIP RESULT PACK AND CCU DELIVERY
The metadata FIFO travels beside the skip MV;
it is not issued to MC as a second candidate.
Both fields enter the final MRG result word.
• AVC does not syntactically force MRG cand_sel to 0
The two-cost toggle register is disabled in AVC mode,
but cand_sel remains part of the current RTL pack logic.
SATD/SSE selected by cand_sel · mrg_idx = cand_sel
Push occurs on cand_pop[2] after the MC-cost handshake.
Consumes the MC-evaluated AVC P-Skip candidate
beside the normal AMVP inter result.
Coding-mode decision remains in the downstream CCU.
MRG does not build a normal HEVC Merge list.
This evaluates a P-Skip option for an AVC inter transaction;
cur_cu_is_skip=1 itself is filtered before the AMVP command FIFO.
AMVP cand0 median + FME MV → normal inter result to CCU; the blk16 pop simultaneously derives avc_mvpxy and sends avc_* to MRG.
MRG FIFO[2]/[3] → one blk16 MC candidate + metadata → MC cost → MRG result FIFO[1] → CCU Skip-mode input.
RTL basis: ve_mvp_top.v · ve_amvp_top.v · ve_mrg_top.v · vc_mvp_ctrl.v · vc_mvp_get_neib.v · vc_mvp_cand_gen.v
